facts.fact: 阿莉在城堡寝殿醒来，已数不清多少夜没睡，多数夜晚在房里来回踱步、躺下也翻来覆去。
facts.anchor: I spent most nights pacing the room. When I did lie down in bed, I only tossed and turned.

facts.fact: 紫猫 Chez 凭空出现在阿莉的寝殿地板中央，跨步走来并向她打招呼。
facts.anchor: Out of nothingness, a large, furry purple cat materialized, crossing the floor.

facts.fact: Chez 告诉阿莉：整个 Wünder 流传国王新得一位女巫、由她决定市民生死的传言；阿莉张口否认，说自己只想帮人。
facts.anchor: There is talk of His Majesty having acquired a new sorceress. She who decides which citizens live or die.

facts.fact: 阿莉自述她凭心中残余力量感应他人意图，审问市民以判断其忠诚，目的是不让国王伤害无辜。
facts.anchor: I question the citizens, determine where their loyalties lie. I try to make sure he doesn’t hurt the innocent.

facts.fact: Chez 提出可以帮阿莉逃出这座旧城堡；阿莉握紧拳头、没有作答（内心是「Yes. No. Maybe.」）。
facts.anchor: Perhaps I can help you escape. I’m still quite familiar with this old castle.

facts.fact: 结尾在大厅：国王始终不看她，只抬手一挥，下令把下一批囚犯带上来。
facts.anchor: His Majesty raised his hand. “Bring in the next group of prisoners.”

facts.fact: 【人物关系】Chez 与 Duchess（公爵夫人）站在阿莉一边、替她操心；Chez 是从塔楼追来、替 Duchess 传话的旧识。
facts.anchor: Knowing Chez and the Duchess were on my side, looking out for me, was a welcome reassurance.

facts.fact: 【数字/时长】「For several months」——属于阿莉本人：她已持续数月说服自己不再与身为国王的那个男人有任何瓜葛。
